hero.headline: Build Your Team. Grow Your Business.
hero.subheadline: Find the right people for your business with a streamlined permanent staffing and recruitment solution — from kitchen and service staff to skilled trades and office roles.
hero.note: Permanent placements for businesses. Not a temporary or gig staffing service.

valueProposition.title: Hiring, organised around how your business actually works
valueProposition.intro: Each requirement is captured in a structured way so the right staff category, budget and timeline are clear from the start.

items.title: Simplified hiring process
items.description: Share your requirement once. We work through category, budget and timeline with you in a clear, step-by-step process.

items.title: Multiple staffing categories
items.description: Kitchen, service, housekeeping, security, office and skilled trade roles are covered under one engagement.

items.title: Budget-oriented hiring
items.description: Indicative salary ranges are shared upfront so you can plan hiring around what your business can sustain.

items.title: Business-focused recruitment
items.description: Requirements are discussed with the business owner or manager, not sold as a generic job listing.

items.title: Structured hiring requirements
items.description: Role, headcount, budget and timeline are recorded as a single brief that both sides can refer back to.

staffCategories.title: Staff categories
staffCategories.intro: Permanent roles commonly requested by restaurants, hotels, offices, stores and commercial establishments.

services.title: Staffing solutions by industry
services.intro: Services are organised by the type of business you run, so each conversation starts from the roles that matter to you.

pricing.title: Hiring budgets
pricing.intro: Monthly salary, daily booking rates and placement fees are shown separately so there is no confusion about who pays what. Chefs and waiters can also be booked per day.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.intro: A four-step process from first conversation to a confirmed hire.

steps.title: Share your requirements
steps.description: Tell us the role, number of employees, location, indicative budget and when you need them.

steps.title: Explore suitable staff categories
steps.description: Review the categories that match your requirement, along with indicative salary ranges.

steps.title: Review hiring details
steps.description: Confirm the role scope, compensation, placement terms and timeline before anything is finalised.

steps.title: Proceed with the hiring process
steps.description: Move ahead with shortlisting, interviews and onboarding of the selected permanent employee.

whyChooseUs.title: Our approach to staffing
whyChooseUs.intro: What you can expect from working with us — described plainly, without inflated claims.

points.title: Permanent placements only
points.description: We focus on employees who join your business on a permanent basis, not short-term or gig arrangements.

points.title: Separate, transparent costs
points.description: Employee salary and recruitment fees are always presented as distinct figures.

points.title: Operational roles understood
points.description: Kitchens, floors, housekeeping and maintenance have different rhythms. Requirements are discussed in those terms.

points.title: One brief, one point of contact
points.description: Your requirement is documented once and followed through by the same team.

ctaBanner.headline: Ready to Build Your Team?
ctaBanner.text: Tell us about your staffing requirements and discover a suitable hiring solution for your business.

testimonials.title: What businesses say
testimonials.intro: Feedback from businesses that have hired through us.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.intro: Common questions about permanent hiring, budgets and how to get started.

finalCta.headline: Start with a single requirement
finalCta.text: Share the role you need to fill. We will come back with suitable categories and indicative budgets.
